title: afraid of ... good at ... etc. (preposition + -ing)
summary: Прилагательные и глаголы с предлогами (**afraid of, good at, interested in, thank you for**), после которых глагол ставится в форме **-ing**.
ru:
## Прилагательное + предлог
Многие прилагательные всегда идут с определённым предлогом.
- **afraid of** — бояться: *I'm **afraid of** dogs.*
- **good at / bad at** — хорошо / плохо что-то делать: *She's **good at** maths.*
- **interested in** — интересоваться: *Are you **interested in** art?*
- **fond of** — любить, быть привязанным: *He's **fond of** animals.*
- **tired of / bored with** — уставать от, надоело: *I'm **tired of** waiting.*
- **different from**, **married to**, **angry with / about**, **proud of**, **ready for**, **sorry for / about**, **excited about**

## Предлог + глагол в форме -ing
Если после предлога стоит глагол, он принимает форму **-ing** (никогда не to + глагол и не просто основа).
> I'm afraid **of flying**. — Я боюсь летать.
> He's good **at cooking**. — Он хорошо готовит.
> I'm interested **in learning** Italian. — Я интересуюсь изучением итальянского.
> Thank you **for helping** me. — Спасибо, что помогли мне.

## Другие частые модели
- **before / after / without / instead of / by + -ing**
> **Before leaving**, check the windows. — Перед уходом проверь окна.
> She left **without saying** goodbye. — Она ушла, не попрощавшись.
> You can improve your English **by reading** a lot. — Можно улучшить английский, много читая.
> **How about** going to the cinema? — Как насчёт кино?

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I'm afraid to flying.~~ → I'm afraid **of flying**.
- ~~She's good in cooking.~~ → She's good **at cooking**.
- ~~Thank you for help me.~~ → Thank you **for helping** me.
- ~~He left without to say goodbye.~~ → **without saying**.
- ~~I'm interested to learn.~~ → I'm interested **in learning**.
en:
## Adjective + preposition
Many adjectives are always followed by a certain preposition.
- **afraid of**: *I'm **afraid of** dogs.*
- **good at / bad at**: *She's **good at** maths.*
- **interested in**: *Are you **interested in** art?*
- **fond of**: *He's **fond of** animals.*
- **tired of / bored with**: *I'm **tired of** waiting.*
- also: **different from, married to, angry with / about, proud of, ready for, sorry for / about, excited about**

## Preposition + -ing
When a verb comes after a preposition, it ends in **-ing**.
> I'm afraid **of flying**.
> He's good **at cooking**.
> I'm interested **in learning** Italian.
> Thank you **for helping** me.

## Other common patterns
- **before / after / without / instead of / by + -ing**
> **Before leaving**, check the windows.
> She left **without saying** goodbye.
> You can improve your English **by reading** a lot.
> **How about** going to the cinema?

## Common mistakes
- ~~I'm afraid to flying.~~ → I'm afraid **of flying**.
- ~~She's good in cooking.~~ → She's good **at cooking**.
- ~~Thank you for help me.~~ → Thank you **for helping** me.
structure:
## Формулы
> **be** + прилагательное + **предлог** + существительное / **-ing**
> She **is good at** drawing. · They **are afraid of** spiders.
> **Предлог** + глагол**-ing**
> **Thank you for** coming. · **Before** **leaving**, call me.

## Частые пары
| Прилагательное | Предлог |
|---|---|
| afraid | of |
| good / bad | at |
| interested | in |
| fond / proud / tired | of |
| bored / angry | with |
| excited / worried | about |
| ready | for |

## Правила написания -ing
| Глагол | + -ing |
|---|---|
| cook | cooking |
| make | making (e убираем) |
| swim | swimming (удваиваем m) |
| run | running |
| lie | lying |

## Отрицание
> I'm sorry for **not calling** you. — Простите, что не позвонила.
> перед -ing ставим **not**.

exercises.title: Предлог + -ing
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в форму **-ing**.

items.text: We're tired of {{waiting}} for the bus. (wait)

exercises.title: Какой предлог?
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **of, at, in, for, with, about**.

items.text: My brother is very good {{at}} football.
I'm angry {{with|at}} him for being late.

items.q: You can learn new words ___ films in English.

options: Before going to bed, I read.
He left without to have breakfast.

exercises.title: Составьте предложения
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложение из слов в скобках. Следите за формой глагола.

answers: I am interested in learning English.
They're afraid of driving at night.
They are afraid of driving at night.
I am not good at cooking.
She's afraid of riding a bike.
She is afraid of riding a bike.
She's afraid of riding a bicycle.
She is afraid of riding a bicycle.
My brother is interested in music.

answers: She left without saying a word.
She went out without saying a word.
She went out without saying anything.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями о себе. Проверьте по образцу.

items.sample: I'm good at drawing and cooking.

items.prompt: What do you do before going to bed?
items.sample: Before going to bed, I read a book for half an hour.

items.prompt: How do you improve your English?
